_comment: Control Catalog 唯一正本(PR A3)。docs/CONTROL-CATALOG.md 由 scripts/render-control-catalog.ts 渲染、npm run check:catalog 驗一致與 ci.yml 雙向鎖;改本檔後跑 npm run catalog:render。schema / loader:scripts/lib/control-catalog.ts。implementation 只准精確 tracked 檔案路徑;章節 / 外部工具寫在 locator。ciSetupSteps 是 ci.yml 內不需登錄為 control 的 setup step(權威豁免清單,checker 驗每個名稱恰出現 1 次且不與任何 ciStep 重疊)。
ciSetupSteps: Fetch delivery refs (for TODOS Markers Check)

controls.name: Secret scan(gitleaks 全史)
controls.locator: CI step「Secret scan (gitleaks)」;pinned binary + sha256 校驗;全史、無 grandfather
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;失敗時 job log 列出 leak 位置(--redact)
controls.degradation: 本機 pre-push 有同款 gitleaks(CTRL-HOOK-003),但那是 soft;CI 這道是唯一 hard 的秘密掃描
controls.bypass: admin override(branch protection 設定;本 repo 未機器驗證,見 CTRL-GOV-005)
controls.notes: 與 source-term(CTRL-CI-009)是兩條獨立政策,只共用 CI job

controls.name: Typecheck
controls.locator: CI step「Typecheck」= tsc --noEmit;本機 npm run typecheck
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;本機 exit code
controls.degradation: 無(tsc 是 devDependency,離線可跑)
controls.bypass: admin override

controls.name: Lint
controls.locator: CI step「Lint」= eslint .;L2 stack 另掛 harness/* AST 規則
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;本機 exit code
controls.degradation: 無
controls.bypass: admin override

controls.name: Dependency audit(high / critical 硬擋)
controls.locator: CI step「Dependency audit (high/critical 硬 gate)」= npm audit --audit-level=high
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;moderate / low 只印不擋
controls.degradation: 本機 npm audit;無網路時無法判定
controls.bypass: admin override
controls.notes: 只有 high / critical 擋;中低風險 CVE 可見不擋(刻意)

controls.name: 文件檔案引用完整性
controls.locator: CI step「Doc Refs Check」;掃 docs/**、.claude/sop、.claude/memory 的檔案引用
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;本機 npm run check:doc-refs 列出失效引用
controls.degradation: 無
controls.bypass: admin override
controls.notes: 只讀 .md;.yml / .json / .ts 內的引用不驗;#anchor 不驗(ADR 已知限制第 5 條)

controls.name: 記憶檔大小額度
controls.locator: CI step「Doc Size Check」;progress.md 20 KB / LESSONS.md 60 KB,額度數字由測試釘住
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;本機 npm run check:doc-size 印各檔 %
controls.degradation: 無
controls.bypass: admin override;調額度須改測試釘值並寫理由

controls.name: Adoption readiness(宣告式 mode)
controls.locator: CI step「Adoption Readiness Check」;template mode 列 exception、adopted mode fail-closed
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;本機 exit 0 = READY / 2 = NOT_READY 或無法判定
controls.degradation: 無;config 缺 / 壞一律 exit 2
controls.bypass: admin override
controls.notes: mode 是顯式靜態宣告;無 runtime 偵測、無 env override

controls.name: TODOS marker 治理(完成宣稱需 merge 證據)
controls.locator: CI step「TODOS Markers Check」;PR event 一律跑、push 只在 delivery branch 跑
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;引用的 PR 號需在 delivery refs 有 merge 證據
controls.degradation: 本機 npm run check:todos(需 origin refs)
controls.bypass: admin override;MARKER_SELF_PR 允許同 PR 自我引用(刻意)
controls.notes: 缺 merge 證據 → block;已完工但沒引用 PR 號 → 只 warn(advisory 部分)

controls.name: Source-term 去識別化掃描
controls.locator: CI step「Source-term scan (de-identification gate)」;current tree 全量 + baseline..HEAD per-commit diff + commit 訊息
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;hit 列 rev 前 8 碼 + 內容片段
controls.degradation: 下游 fork 找不到 template baseline → 降級全史掃描並印 warning;shallow clone fail-closed
controls.bypass: admin override;baseline 變更走 CTRL-GOV-002(人工授權),機器守門見 ADR 已知限制第 2 條的處置
controls.notes: 已知限制第 1 條:diff hit 缺精確 file:line 屬診斷精度、不影響判定,登錄於此、無排程修復

controls.name: 測試套件(vitest)
controls.locator: CI step「Test (vitest)」;本機 npm test
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;測試檔 / 通過數在 job log
controls.degradation: 無
controls.bypass: admin override;skipped 測試不算失敗(原則 7:有 skip 要說明)

controls.name: Control catalog conformance
controls.locator: CI step「Control Catalog Check」;路徑 tracked + ci.yml 雙向鎖(ciSetupSteps 豁免)+ 渲染一致
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;本機 npm run check:catalog 印 CATALOG_OK / CATALOG_FAIL 逐條 code
controls.degradation: 無;catalog 缺 / 壞一律 exit 2
controls.bypass: admin override
controls.notes: 機器不驗 locator / evidence / degradation / bypass / notes 的文字內容(誠實邊界,見渲染檔檔頭)

controls.name: Baseline governance(baseline 變更旁路機器守門)
controls.locator: CI step「Baseline Governance Check」(pull_request only);merge-base 對 HEAD 比 source-term baseline 值
controls.evidence: CI check 狀態;本機 npm run check:baseline-governance -- --base=<ref> 印 UNCHANGED / OK / FAIL 逐條 code
controls.degradation: base ref 未 fetch 或 shallow → exit 2(無法判定,不放行)
controls.bypass: admin override
controls.notes: 人工段 = CTRL-GOV-002(Owner 授權);本條只擋機器可判的旁路形狀,不判斷推進理由是否正當

controls.name: pre-commit:保護分支 code 守衛
controls.locator: develop / main 上 staged 含 code 或 PROTECTED_DOCS → block;feature/* 放行
controls.evidence: hook stderr;npm run check:hooks 驗 hook 活著
controls.degradation: 沒跑 npm run setup-hooks 就不存在;CI 端由 branch protection 補(未機器驗證)
controls.bypass: --no-verify;未安裝 hooks
controls.notes: 縱深用;不能假設遠端一定守得住

controls.name: commit-msg:訊息去識別化 denylist
controls.locator: 訊息含 denylist 詞 → block;scripts/deny-terms.txt 不在時 no-op
controls.evidence: hook stderr
controls.degradation: CI 的 CTRL-CI-009 掃 commit 訊息全史兜底
controls.bypass: --no-verify

controls.name: pre-push:本機 gitleaks + 保護分支 push 守衛
controls.locator: 先跑 gitleaks(有 leak 硬擋)再做保護分支 code push 確認;刪保護分支硬擋
controls.evidence: hook stderr
controls.degradation: 本機無 gitleaks → 該段略過並提示;CI CTRL-CI-001 兜底
controls.bypass: --no-verify

controls.name: Destructive 腳本四層守衛
controls.locator: NODE_ENV / DATABASE_URL 含 prod / FLAG_ENV / --confirm token + dry-run 預設
controls.evidence: 腳本 stderr 摘要(DRY-RUN / APPLY)
controls.degradation: 腳本不 import guard 就沒有守衛;採用者 adopted mode 由 CTRL-CI-007 驗常數已改
controls.bypass: 改常數;不 import guard;env 與 token 都是本機可設值
controls.notes: ⚠️ 誠實定位(不變量 I6):固定 token + prod 字串偵測是 accident interlock(防誤觸),不是 production security boundary;真正 apply 應驗 target identity 與影響範圍(Milestone C)

controls.name: Plan Mode 7 步 SOP + STOP point
controls.locator: CLAUDE.md Part 2「Plan Mode 流程規則」;checklist 每步 STOP point 與 effort 建議
controls.evidence: plan file + progress entry 的 7 步 checklist 狀態
controls.degradation: 外部工具缺席照 DEGRADATION.md 降級,骨架不變
controls.bypass: Owner 明示 trivial 例外(typo / 單行 / 純格式),受 docs-only 判準約束
controls.notes: 人守;機器只驗其產物(progress entry 由 CTRL-SOP-007 / CTRL-CI-006)

controls.name: 跨模型 review(Step 4)
controls.locator: Step 4;外部 Codex CLI 對本地 diff 迭代到 0 findings;三條壓輪數紀律
controls.evidence: progress entry 的 round 數 / P1 / P2;fix commit 訊息標 round
controls.degradation: 無 Codex → Claude Code 內建 /code-review(失去跨模型多樣性)
controls.bypass: docs-only 車道可略 Step 4(判不準從嚴)
controls.notes: cross-model agreement 實測接近 0,兩道 review 都不可省

controls.name: CSO 觸發判定 + 高風險車道探針
controls.locator: Step 4.5;判定機器化(完整變更面 vs 路徑表,fail-closed exit 2)、探針執行靠人
controls.evidence: progress entry 記 CSO_REQUIRED / NOT + 命中域 + 探針 exit 0 綁定 SHA
controls.degradation: 無 gstack /cso → 內建 security-review;模板 repo 表空 = 例外人工判定
controls.bypass: 本機不跑即無;判定是下限不是上限
controls.notes: 不是 CI gate(CI 跑不了 /cso)

controls.name: 條件式視覺關
controls.locator: Step 4.6;diff 碰 UI 才觸發;外部 gstack /design-review,降級為實際截圖比對
controls.evidence: progress entry 記觸發與否 + before / after 截圖
controls.degradation: 無 gstack → 手動截圖;不得只讀碼推論外觀
controls.bypass: 未觸發即不跑(純後端 / 純文件 sprint)

controls.name: Step 5 對抗審 + 高風險車道 worktree 獨立審
controls.locator: Step 5;全新拋棄式 clone、40 字元 review-tip 核對、findings 全報再按軸過濾
controls.evidence: progress entry 記 CRITICAL / INFORMATIONAL 數、review-tip SHA、Step5 獨立發現數
controls.degradation: 無 gstack /review → 內建 /code-review + 一個 adversarial-reviewer
controls.bypass: none(SOP 內無例外;docs-only 車道仍跑 fresh review)

controls.name: 量詞自檢器
controls.locator: 送審前對自己 diff 新增行掃過度宣稱,產待處置清單
controls.evidence: progress entry 與 PR 描述的逐條處置(留 A / 降級 B)
controls.degradation: 無工具 → 人工核對新增宣稱句
controls.bypass: 刻意非 gate;命中不代表錯

controls.name: Bookkeeping commit 機器化核對
controls.locator: Step 5 收尾;純檔名 allowlist(progress / TODOS / BACKLOG / progress-archive 非 README)
controls.evidence: 本機 exit code;progress entry 記結果
controls.degradation: 無
controls.bypass: 本機不跑即無;v1 只看檔名不看內容

controls.name: 三層行為守則
controls.locator: Part 1(工作原則)/ Part 2(協作偏好)/ Part 3(放寬規則);D 編號可否決機制
controls.evidence: plan file 的 Sensible Defaults 段;Owner 否決紀錄
controls.degradation: 無
controls.bypass: none(行為守則無機器強制;偏差由 Owner redirect)
controls.notes: CLAUDE.md 屬 PROTECTED_DOCS(CTRL-HOOK-001 / 003 擋直推)

controls.name: 記憶層與歸檔慣例
controls.locator: progress 每 sprint 一 entry(pre-merge schema)、LESSONS 踩坑即寫、TODOS 完成宣稱引 PR 號;超額度歸檔
controls.evidence: 檔案內容;額度由 CTRL-CI-006、marker 由 CTRL-CI-008 機器驗
controls.degradation: 無 gbrain → 純 git 核實
controls.bypass: none
controls.notes: 歸檔會搬動 canonical ADR 引用 → 同 commit 更新 template-governance 的位置＋數量表

controls.name: 週健檢
controls.locator: 三個 collector:工作累積 / 教訓產出速率 / 審查鈍化偵測;輸出 .claude/memory/health-history/
controls.evidence: health-history 週報
controls.degradation: 不排程即無;兩個 collector 明文未實作
controls.bypass: 不排程即無

controls.name: Baseline 變更授權(人工段)
controls.locator: H2「baseline 變更授權」:baseline 是治理決策,改動走 PR + Owner 拍板
controls.evidence: PR 描述 + Owner approve 紀錄
controls.degradation: 無
controls.bypass: Owner
controls.notes: 機器守門(同 PR 推 baseline 洗白)屬 ADR 已知限制第 2 條,由 catalog 批次處置

controls.name: 長命 pre-baseline 分支的清理程序(ADR 已知限制第 3 條)
controls.locator: H2「長命 pre-baseline 分支的清理程序」:先 rebase 到 post-baseline;不行則走獨立 baseline PR(受 CTRL-CI-012);再不行 admin override 留紀錄
controls.evidence: PR 描述列出誤紅 hit 與 grandfathered 來源;Owner override 紀錄
controls.degradation: 無;本程序承接的是誤紅方向,漏抓方向(第 8 條)另案
controls.bypass: Owner(admin override 屬本程序第 3 步,須留紀錄)
controls.notes: 刻意不修掃描器(混合掃描策略屬架構級變更);catalog 登錄 + 明文程序即為本條的處置

controls.name: 季 retro 與封存
controls.locator: 封存已機器化教訓、記憶防膨脹、掃文件交叉引用防漂移
controls.evidence: archive 目錄內容
controls.degradation: 無
controls.bypass: none

controls.name: GitHub branch protection
controls.locator: ci.yml 檔頭註解建議設 branch protection(主線要求 CI pass);GitHub 端設定非本 repo 內可驗
controls.evidence: 無(repo 內無證據;Milestone C 才做 governance verification)
controls.degradation: 無 branch protection 時所有 hard-automated 的 admin override 等於任何人可 merge 紅 PR
controls.bypass: github
controls.notes: ⚠️ 本 repo 的 hard-automated controls 之所以「hard」依賴這條設定存在;目前只能建議、不能驗證
